title: Rating component for React feedback and reviews
description: Rating component for React and Next.js with star, heart, flame, thumb, and custom react-icons support, half-step values, accessible radiogroup semantics, and form-friendly hidden input output.

og.title: Rating · Zentauri UI

intro: Rating renders an interactive review control for product scores, customer sentiment, support quality, marketplace cards, and survey feedback. It supports controlled and uncontrolled values, half-step selection, clear-on-repeat behavior, read-only aggregate displays, hidden form values, and icon presets powered by react-icons.
useCases: Product review and marketplace rating forms.
Customer satisfaction, support quality, and feature feedback prompts.
Read-only aggregate ratings in cards, tables, and dashboards.
Survey inputs that use stars, hearts, flames, thumbs, or custom icons.

faqs.question: Can Rating collect half-star values?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pass allowHalf to expose half-step radio options and keep the fill clipped to the selected fractional value.

faqs.question: Can I use icons other than stars?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the built-in star, heart, flame, and thumb presets, or pass any react-icons component through the icon prop.

faqs.question: Does Rating work in forms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pass name to render a hidden input with the current numeric rating value.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Provide a polished rating primitive with animated fill clipping, hover previews, keyboard stepping, and the same appearance system used across Zentauri UI components.

The component keeps the visual icon row separate from the radio options so half-step values stay accessible while the display remains compact.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Import Rating from the rating entrypoint. Use value and onValueChange for controlled state, or defaultValue for uncontrolled state. Tune the control with max, allowHalf, allowClear, readOnly, disabled, name, size, appearance, icon, getLabel, hint, and errorMessage.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Rating renders a role=radiogroup wrapper with individual role=radio options. Provide label text, use hint for helper copy, and customize getLabel when your scoring language needs more context than the default numeric value.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Use Rating in client components when the selected value changes in the browser. Read-only aggregate displays can be rendered from server data, while interactive feedback forms should submit the hidden input or controlled value to your own server action or API route.
